title: Yorkshire Pudding
description: A traditional United Kingdom dish made with all-purpose flour, chicken egg, whole cow milk. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 30 minutes until properly chilled.
Preheat the dripping in the muffin tin until smoking hot, pour in the cold batter, and bake at 220°C without opening the oven until dramatically puffed and deep golden.
